measurement.ordering: alternating baseline/head; pair order reversed on each iteration
measurement.primary_clock: page performance.now; target DOM or input event through requestAnimationFrame then zero-delay task
measurement.observed_clock: Node performance.now; includes Playwright IPC, actionability and polling
measurement.cache: one browser process; new HTTP context per cold navigation; warm OS/files/server; browser-wide WASM/code caches may persist
measurement.transition: real navigation-link click in an already loaded context
measurement.bytes: completed ResourceTiming entries at readiness plus navigation document; transfer/encoded/decoded bytes; late/background requests may be omitted; no URLs
measurement.limits: no CPU/network throttling; Chromium only; rendering opportunity is not actual pixel presentation or INP; insertText does not exercise IME conversion; no traces/videos/screenshots

provenance.ui_source: embedded production assets; no ui-dir override
